| [`underflow-from-next-page-print.html`](https://wpt.fyi/results/css/css-break/underflow-from-next-page-print.html) | Fail | 0 / 1 | BUG | a box after a forced page break with a negative block-start margin (`margin-top: -50vh`): the forced break is at the end of the paragraph before the box, and the box is placed before it in the strip (the margins after a forced break are preserved: the break is at `max(end of the content before, start of the box - its positive margin)`), so it ends on the first page and there is no second page. Blink starts the second page with the box at a negative offset (-50vh), and the reference expects `PASS` at the middle of the first page: the part of the box above the page area of the second page is painted in the first page (the pages show the content stitched across them): both the break after the box and the painting of the content of a page that underflows into the previous page are missing (the page area clips the content of its page); Firefox fails it too |
